content: E-commerce cart/order domain: Cart/CartItem is ephemeral pre-checkout state; Order/OrderItem is an immutable snapshot created at checkout; inventory should track available/reserved/committed stock explicitly with reservations that expire, and stock decrement + order creation should happen atomically inside one DB transaction (EF Core SaveChanges wraps single calls in an implicit transaction; multi-step flows need an explicit TransactionScope/BeginTransaction).
